summary: Small netball-club car park, homes 28 m or more away behind trees.

best_section.where: South edge of the small car park, next to the netball courts

drivers.traffic: Dead-end club car park, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: A few cars parked in Esri; sport club use, overnight stays unproven.
